column1: # Predictions written before the controls workbook's fresh Excel export/measurement (2026-11-23T18:15Z).
# Metric: Poppler word box (pdftotext -bbox xMax) to the printed #FFF2CC fill's right edge (physical cell border),
# never raster ink. Pairs are adjacent numeric/literal rows with identical displayed text, face, size, italic,
# alignment, column width, fill and border.
# Primary hypothesis (source independence): a numeric cell and a literal text cell with the same displayed string
# have the same word box and therefore the same word-gap. Accept |literal_gap - numeric_gap| <= 0.05 pt for Excel
# and ours. Corollary: any italic reserve is a property of the rendered string/face/size, not of number formatting.
# Secondary: our engine applies no italic placement reserve; predicted reserve 0.000 for every observed pair.
# Pair identity must also hold: equal pdftotext text, equal pdffonts/pdftohtml font, word-box width difference
# <= 0.01 pt. A failed identity is a confound, not a pass.

# state only relations that do not use the new export.
